title: An Efficient Liquidity Savings Mechanism
title_zh: 一种高效的流动性储蓄机制
title_primary: 一种高效的流动性储蓄机制
title_secondary: An Efficient Liquidity Savings Mechanism
authors: Darrell Duffie, Srisht F. Singh, Chaojun Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Liquidity savings mechanisms (LSMs) reduce the quantity of reserve balances that banks need to process payments. An LSM can mitigate coordination failures in which banks delay their payments to each other because they expect that other banks will do the same. We provide the design and properties of a maximally efficient new form of LSM.
abstract_zh: 流动性节约机制（LSMs）减少了银行处理支付所需的准备金余额数量。LSM能够缓解协调失灵问题，即银行因预期其他银行也会延迟支付而相互拖延付款。我们提供了一种效率最大化的新型LSM的设计及其特性。

title: DP21139 Specialization, Complexity, and Resilience in Supply Chains
title_zh: 供应链中的专业化、复杂性与韧性
title_primary: 供应链中的专业化、复杂性与韧性
title_secondary: DP21139 Specialization, Complexity, and Resilience in Supply Chains
authors: Alessandro Ferrari, Lorenzo Pesaresi
official: 官方在线 2026-02-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how product specialization choices affect supply chain resilience. We propose a theory of supply chain formation in which only compatible inputs can be used in final production. Intermediate producers choose how much to specialize their goods, trading off higher value added against a smaller pool of compatible final producers. Final producers operate complex supply chains, requiring multiple complementary inputs. Specialization choices determine how quickly final producers can replace suppliers after disruptions, and thus supply chain resilience. In equilibrium, production inputs are over-specialized due to a novel network externality. Intermediate producers fail to internalize how their specialization choices affect the likelihood that final producers source all required inputs, and therefore the lost value added from complementary inputs if production halts. As a result, supply chains are more productive in normal times but less resilient than socially desirable. We characterize the optimal transfer that restores the efficient allocation and show that non-fiscal interventions, such as compatibility standards, are generally welfare-enhancing.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了产品专业化选择如何影响供应链韧性。我们提出了一种供应链形成理论，其中只有兼容的投入品才能用于最终生产。中间品生产商选择其产品的专业化程度，在更高附加值与其最终生产商兼容池较小之间权衡取舍。最终生产商运营着复杂的供应链，需要多种互补性投入。专业化选择决定了最终生产商在遭遇中断后更换供应商的速度，进而影响供应链韧性。在均衡状态下，由于一种新颖的网络外部性，生产投入品存在过度专业化现象。中间品生产商未能内化其专业化选择对最终生产商获取所有必需投入品可能性的影响，以及由此在生产停滞时互补性投入品所损失的价值增值。因此，供应链在正常时期更具生产力，但韧性却低于社会最优水平。我们刻画了恢复有效配置的最优转移支付，并表明非财政干预措施，如兼容性标准，通常能增进福利。

title: Rural Straw Burning and Its External Impacts on Urbanites' Happiness in China
title_zh: 中国农村秸秆焚烧及其对城市居民幸福感的外部影响
title_primary: 中国农村秸秆焚烧及其对城市居民幸福感的外部影响
title_secondary: Rural Straw Burning and Its External Impacts on Urbanites' Happiness in China
authors: Jinfeng Gao, Jianglong Li
official: 官方在线 2026-08-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the impact of cross‐regional pollution from rural straw burning on the happiness of urban residents. Specifically, we investigate how drifting particulate matter from straw burning, which travels far from its source, influences the well‐being of those in affected urban areas. By combining high‐resolution satellite data on agricultural fires with self‐reported happiness data, we estimate that a one‐standard‐deviation increase in agricultural fires—measured by the number of upwind fire points, fire intensity (proxied by brightness temperature), and fire radiative power—reduces happiness by approximately 0.099, 0.098, and 0.079 points on the CES‐D scale, respectively. Using the pollution decay function, we further quantify the contribution of straw burning to urban particulate matter (PM 2.5 ) levels and explore the channels through which PM 2.5 exposure diminishes happiness, including both objective and subjective factors. From an economic perspective, a simple back‐of‐the‐envelope calculation suggests that the implied welfare losses may exceed current government spending on straw management. These findings highlight the high social and economic costs of agricultural fires and underscore the urgent need for coordinated policy responses in agriculture‐dependent developing economies experiencing similar challenges.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了农村秸秆焚烧产生的跨区域污染对城市居民幸福感的影响。具体而言，我们考察了秸秆焚烧产生的飘散颗粒物如何远距离传输，进而影响受影响城市地区居民的福祉。通过将高分辨率卫星农业火灾数据与自我报告的幸福感数据相结合，我们估算出农业火灾的一个标准差增加——以逆风火点数、火点强度（以亮温为代理指标）及火辐射功率衡量——分别使CES-D量表上的幸福感降低约0.099、0.098和0.079分。利用污染衰减函数，我们进一步量化了秸秆焚烧对城市颗粒物（PM 2.5）浓度的贡献，并探讨了PM 2.5暴露降低幸福感的传导渠道，包括客观与主观因素。从经济学角度看，一项简单的粗略估算表明，由此隐含的福利损失可能超过当前政府在秸秆管理上的支出。这些发现凸显了农业火灾高昂的社会与经济成本，并强调了在面临类似挑战、以农业为主的发展中经济体中，亟需采取协调一致的政策应对措施。

title: The effect of regulatory tightening on the information content of insider trades
title_zh: 监管收紧对内部人交易信息含量的影响
title_primary: 监管收紧对内部人交易信息含量的影响
title_secondary: The effect of regulatory tightening on the information content of insider trades
authors: Chakrapani Chaturvedula, Rajeev Kumar Shahi, Nikhil Rastogi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Regulatory tightening aims to curb opportunistic insider trading by reducing informational advantages. However, the effectiveness of such reforms, particularly in emerging markets with historically weak enforcement, remains debated. This study investigates the effect of regulatory tightening on the information content of insider trades in India, an emerging market. We focus on the implementation of the Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations 2015, which introduced stricter disclosure requirements, higher penalties, and a reversal of the burden of proof. Using a comprehensive sample of insider trades from 2008 to 2024, we employ difference-in-differences and propensity score matching to assess changes in the predictive power of insider trades for future stock returns. Our findings indicate that the regulatory reforms did not diminish the overall informativeness of insider trades. Notably, while insider purchases retained their positive predictive value, insider sales, previously uninformative, gained significant negative information content post-regulation. These results suggest that enhanced enforcement may amplify rather than suppress the market’s ability to incorporate insider information, underscoring the role of rigorous implementation in emerging markets. We recommend that regulators prioritize enforcement mechanisms to balance investor protection with market efficiency.
abstract_zh: 监管收紧旨在通过减少信息优势来遏制机会主义的内幕交易。然而，此类改革的有效性，尤其是在历史上执法薄弱的新兴市场中，仍存在争议。本研究探讨了监管收紧对印度这一新兴市场中内幕交易信息含量的影响。我们聚焦于2015年《内幕交易禁止条例》的实施，该条例引入了更严格的披露要求、更高的罚款以及举证责任的倒置。利用2008年至2024年间全面的内幕交易样本，我们采用双重差分法和倾向得分匹配来评估内幕交易对未来股票收益预测能力的变化。研究发现，监管改革并未削弱内幕交易的整体信息含量。值得注意的是，尽管内幕买入保持了其正向预测价值，而此前无信息含量的内幕卖出在监管后获得了显著的负向信息含量。这些结果表明，加强执法可能放大而非抑制市场吸收内幕信息的能力，凸显了在新兴市场中严格实施的重要性。我们建议监管机构优先考虑执法机制，以平衡投资者保护与市场效率。

title: Monetary policy, state-dependent bank capital requirements and the role of non-bank financial intermediaries
title_zh: 货币政策、状态依赖的银行资本要求与非银行金融中介的作用
title_primary: 货币政策、状态依赖的银行资本要求与非银行金融中介的作用
title_secondary: Monetary policy, state-dependent bank capital requirements and the role of non-bank financial intermediaries
authors: Manuel Gloria & Chiara Punzo
official: 官方在线 2025-11-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a DSGE model that incorporates state-dependent commercial bank capital requirements as a source of non-linearity. The presence of non-bank financial institutions (NBFI) amplifies the contractionary effects of monetary policy, primarily through the asset price channel. The amplification effect is strongest in the left tail of the GDP distribution and remains pronounced under zero lower bound conditions. The short-run vulnerabilities exposed by NBFIs contrast with their long-run benefits: a greater share of NBFI lending is associated with higher welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含状态依赖型商业银行资本要求的DSGE模型，以此作为非线性的来源。非银行金融机构（NBFI）的存在放大了货币政策的紧缩效应，主要通过资产价格渠道实现。这种放大效应在GDP分布的左尾最为显著，并且在零利率下限条件下依然突出。NBFI所暴露的短期脆弱性与其长期益处形成对比：NBFI贷款份额的增加与更高的福利水平相关联。

title: The Effect of Extreme Temperature Shocks on the Type of Firm Labor Hired
title_zh: 极端温度冲击对企业雇佣劳动力类型的影响
title_primary: 极端温度冲击对企业雇佣劳动力类型的影响
title_secondary: The Effect of Extreme Temperature Shocks on the Type of Firm Labor Hired
authors: Kairon Shayne D. Garcia, Gregmar I. Galinato, Asif M. Islam
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The article estimates the effect of extreme temperature on labor in the manufacturing and services sectors in the Philippines. We use firm-level survey and temperature data and exploit the exogenous annual variation of maximum temperature. We find a rise in the projected annual increase of extreme temperature from climate change by 0.08℃, reduces employment by 14 workers for a firm with 136 employees in export-focused industries in dry regions. Male, temporary, skilled workers in large, technology-dependent, non-food firms, are most affected by extreme temperature. The mechanism is the reduction in capital investment leading to a complementary reduction in labor hired.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了极端温度对菲律宾制造业和服务业部门劳动力的影响。我们利用企业层面调查数据和温度数据，并借助最高温度的外生年度变化进行分析。研究发现，气候变化导致的极端温度预计年均上升0.08℃，将使干旱地区出口导向型行业中拥有136名员工的企业减少14个就业岗位。大型、技术依赖型、非食品类企业中的男性、临时工、熟练工人受极端温度影响最为显著。其作用机制在于资本投资减少，进而导致雇佣劳动力出现互补性下降。

title: 贸易冲击如何影响中国劳动力市场——基于数量、结构和技能的多重视角

authors: 宋弘, 陈卓, 李婕, 谢慧华
official: 官方发布 2026-07-20 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 近年来，持续演化的贸易冲击对中国劳动力市场产生了复杂而深远的影响。关税频繁变动对劳动力市场的影响不仅关系到就业总量稳定，也关系到岗位结构与技能配置的再平衡，是高质量就业发展进程中不可忽视的外部变量。本文基于国内主流招聘平台岗位微观数据，创新性地融合大语言模型与自然语言处理技术，系统识别了美国加征关税对中国城市劳动力需求规模、岗位结构和技能配置的多重影响，并厘清其影响路径和异质性。研究发现，外部加征关税显著抑制了城市线上招聘总量，这一影响主要作用于扩展边际，即招聘企业数量缩减，而非集约边际下企业平均招聘强度下滑。进一步结合工商注册企业数据与企业微观财务数据的分析表明：扩展边际的收缩特征主要体现为企业暂时停止招聘，而非退出市场；贸易冲击推升企业成本并压缩盈利，从而导致企业暂停招聘。异质性分析显示，冲击对低学历、低经验及常规体力技能相关岗位的抑制更强；贸易多元化程度更高、政策环境更稳定的城市表现出更强的就业韧性。本文的研究从数量、结构和技能视角厘清了贸易冲击对中国劳动力市场带来的多重影响，为稳主体、促多元化与促进劳动力转型的政策制定提供实证支撑，也为推动实现高质量充分就业提供经验启示。

title: Immigration's Effect on US Wages and Employment Redux
title_zh: 移民对美国工资与就业的再审视
title_primary: 移民对美国工资与就业的再审视
title_secondary: Immigration's Effect on US Wages and Employment Redux
authors: Alessandro Caiumi, Giovanni Peri
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This article revives and enhances the factor-supply approach to estimate the effects of changes in immigrant supply on wages and employment of US natives. We introduce and validate a skill-based shift-share IV for immigrants’ labor supply. We find a positive impact of immigration on natives' employment and significant imperfect substitutability between natives and immigrants. Consistent with these estimates, we find significant task complementarity and occupational upgrading of native workers in response to immigrants. Finally, we calculate that immigration over 2000-2023 increased wages of non-college-educated natives by 2.6 to 3.4%, with small effects on other groups.
abstract_zh: 本文重新激活并完善了要素供给方法，用以估算移民供给变化对美国本土劳动者工资与就业的影响。我们提出并验证了一种基于技能的偏移份额工具变量，用于衡量移民劳动力供给。研究发现，移民对本土劳动者的就业具有正向影响，且本土劳动者与移民之间存在显著的不完全替代性。与这些估计结果一致，我们还发现本土劳动者在应对移民时表现出显著的任务互补性与职业升级。最后，我们测算得出，2000年至2023年间的移民使未受过大学教育的本土劳动者工资提高了2.6%至3.4%，而对其他群体的影响较小。

title: Reserve Price Competition with Demand Uncertainty
title_zh: 需求不确定下的保留价格竞争
title_primary: 需求不确定下的保留价格竞争
title_secondary: Reserve Price Competition with Demand Uncertainty
authors: Peck, James, Rampal, Jeevant
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We consider duopoly competition under aggregate demand uncertainty, where firms compete by choosing reserve prices and holding uniform-price auctions. Consumers observe their valuation, but not the demand state, commit to a firm and participate in its auction. Our model captures the features of several important markets involving surge pricing during peak periods. If market demand is sufficiently elastic, then equilibrium reserve prices do not bind. If market demand in the low state is sufficiently inelastic, then at least one firm chooses a binding reserve price. We characterize the linear demand case. We also show that more demand uncertainty softens competition.
abstract_zh: 本文研究总需求不确定下的双寡头竞争，企业通过选择保留价格并举行统一价格拍卖进行竞争。消费者观察到自身估值但无法获知需求状态，承诺选择一家企业并参与其拍卖。我们的模型捕捉了多个重要市场中高峰时段动态定价的特征。若市场需求弹性充足，则均衡保留价格不会产生约束；若低需求状态下的市场缺乏弹性，则至少有一家企业会选择具有约束力的保留价格。我们刻画了线性需求情形，并进一步证明需求不确定性的增加会弱化市场竞争。

title: Subjective Earnings Risk
title_zh: 主观收入风险
title_primary: 主观收入风险
title_secondary: Subjective Earnings Risk
authors: Andrew Caplin, Victoria Gregory, Eungik Lee, Søren Leth-Petersen, Johan Sæverud
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We introduce a survey instrument to measure earnings risk allowing for the possibility of quitting or being fired from the current job. We find these transitions to be the key drivers of subjective risk. A link with administrative data provides multiple credibility checks and reveals that subjective earnings risk varies systematically across the population. It is also many times smaller than traditional estimates even when conditioning richly on demographics and job history. We show that subjective earnings risk can help explain why many hold limited liquid assets.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文引入了一种调查工具，用于衡量收入风险，并允许考虑当前工作可能被辞职或解雇的情况。我们发现，这些工作转换是主观风险的关键驱动因素。通过与行政数据的关联，我们进行了多项可信度检验，并揭示出主观收入风险在人群中存在系统性差异。即使在充分控制人口统计特征和工作历史的情况下，主观收入风险仍比传统估计值小很多倍。我们证明，主观收入风险有助于解释为何许多人持有的流动资产有限。

authors: JENS H. E. CHRISTENSEN, SIMON T. HETLAND

abstract: This paper argues that lower government debt issuance is equivalent to a central bank–operated asset purchase program, commonly known as quantitative easing (QE), as both reduce anticipated future bond supply. However, as it involves neither asset purchases nor associated reserves creation, it is labeled passive QE. A novel classification scheme of central bank balance sheet policies ranks passive QE as stimulative. Supportive evidence from a temporary lowering of government debt issuance in Denmark suggests that declines in long‐term yields reflected both reduced term premia, consistent with supply‐induced portfolio balance effects, and increased safety premia, consistent with safe assets scarcity effects.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，政府债务发行减少与央行操作的资产购买计划（即通常所称的量化宽松，QE）具有等效性，因为两者均会降低预期的未来债券供给。然而，由于该过程既不涉及资产购买，也不产生相应的准备金创造，因此被称为**被动型**量化宽松。本文提出了一种新的央行资产负债表政策分类框架，将被动型量化宽松归类为具有刺激效应的政策。来自丹麦临时性降低政府债务发行的实证证据表明，长期收益率下降既反映了期限溢价的降低（与供给驱动的投资组合平衡效应一致），也反映了安全溢价的上升（与安全资产稀缺效应一致）。

title: Promotion through Connections: Favors or Information?
title_zh: 通过关系晋升：人情还是信息？

title_secondary: Promotion through Connections: Favors or Information?
authors: Yann Bramoullé, Kenan Huremovic
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Connections appear to be helpful in many contexts such as obtaining a job, a promotion, a grant, a loan, or publishing a paper. This may be due to favoritism or to information conveyed by connections. Building on earlier work on discrimination, we propose a new method that identifies these channels using data observed at the time of promotion. The method exploits distinct implications of the two effects on the relationship between observables and success. We show that extra information on connected candidates generates excess variance in latent errors while favors yield different promotion thresholds. We characterize the conditions under which both effects are identified and operationalize these ideas econometrically within a semiparametric framework. We also derive testable restrictions of the model and show how to account for connection endogeneity. We reanalyze data on academic promotions in Spain and Italy and political promotions in China. We detect evidence of favoritism for all types of candidates and of information effects for candidates applying to junior positions. We find strong support for the model’s testable restrictions.
abstract_zh: 人脉关系在求职、晋升、获取资助、贷款或发表论文等多种情境中似乎都大有裨益。这既可能源于偏袒行为，也可能归因于人脉所传递的信息。基于早期关于歧视问题的研究，我们提出了一种新方法，利用晋升时观测到的数据来识别上述两种渠道。该方法利用了两种效应在可观测变量与成功结果之间关系上的不同含义。我们证明，关于人脉候选人的额外信息会引发潜在误差的过度方差，而偏袒则会导致不同的晋升门槛。我们刻画了两种效应均能被识别的条件，并在半参数框架内以计量经济学方法实现了这些思想。我们还推导出模型的可检验约束条件，并展示了如何处理人脉关系的内生性问题。我们重新分析了西班牙和意大利的学术晋升数据以及中国的政治晋升数据。研究发现，所有类型的候选人均存在偏袒效应的证据，而申请初级职位的候选人则存在信息效应的证据。模型的可检验约束条件得到了强有力的支持。

title: Exploitation and containment of invasive predators and native prey: A bioeconomic framework for balancing resource use and ecological risk
title_zh: 入侵捕食者与本地猎物的开发与控制：平衡资源利用与生态风险的生物经济框架
title_primary: 入侵捕食者与本地猎物的开发与控制：平衡资源利用与生态风险的生物经济框架
title_secondary: Exploitation and containment of invasive predators and native prey: A bioeconomic framework for balancing resource use and ecological risk
authors: Carmela Marangi, Angela Martiradonna, Stefania Ragni
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Invasive alien species pose major ecological and socio-economic challenges, especially when they exert strong predation pressure on native resources while offering opportunities for commercial use. Addressing this dual role requires models that integrate ecological dynamics, economic incentives, and institutional policies. This paper develops a general bioeconomic framework for a predator–prey system subject to human interventions. The native resource is harvested for economic purposes, while the invasive predator can be controlled through both commercial exploitation and institutional removal. The analysis combines equilibrium methods and optimal control over finite horizons, capturing the interaction between long-run ecological regimes and short-term management objectives. The results characterize threshold conditions for species coexistence and identify how harvesting and institutional removal affect the ecological regimes of the system. The analysis shows that moderate exploitation of the invasive predator can enlarge the coexistence region, whereas eradication requires removal efforts exceeding its intrinsic growth rate. The optimal control analysis highlights the role of coordinated management instruments, with numerical results indicating that mixed market and institutional strategies outperform single-instrument policies. The framework is inspired by the interaction between the invasive blue crab (Callinectes sapidus) and native bivalves in Mediterranean coastal systems, and points to policy strategies that integrate ecological conservation, economic valorization, and institutional containment.
abstract_zh: 外来入侵物种带来了重大的生态和社会经济挑战，尤其是当它们对本地资源施加强烈捕食压力，同时又提供商业利用机会时。应对这种双重角色，需要整合生态动态、经济激励和制度政策的模型。本文针对受人类干预的捕食者—被捕食者系统，构建了一个通用的生物经济框架。本地资源因经济目的而被捕捞，而入侵捕食者则可通过商业开发和制度性清除两种方式进行控制。分析结合了均衡方法和有限时间范围内的最优控制，捕捉了长期生态制度与短期管理目标之间的相互作用。结果刻画了物种共存的条件阈值，并识别了捕捞和制度性清除如何影响系统的生态制度。分析表明，对入侵捕食者的适度开发可以扩大共存区域，而根除则需要清除努力超过其内在增长率。最优控制分析强调了协调管理工具的作用，数值结果表明，市场与制度混合策略优于单一工具政策。该框架受地中海沿海系统中入侵蓝蟹（*Callinectes sapidus*）与本地双壳类之间相互作用的启发，并指向整合生态保护、经济增值和制度遏制相结合的政策策略。

abstract: It is a great privilege to be here, even if it is virtually, to celebrate Jim's impact on the profession, and in international trade in particular. Most of us here will know Jim's work from his seminal papers on trade policy (Brander and Krugman 1983, Brander 1995), and especially his work with his wife Barbara Spencer (Brander and Spencer 1981, 1983, 1985). Regardless, one look at his vita shows that his impact has been across fields, from his work on the environment (Brander and Taylor 1998), a personal favourite, finance (Brander and Lewis 1986, 1988), industrial organization (Brander and Eaton 1984, Brander and Zhang 1990) and business (Perloff and Brander 2017). He has written with many people, including Paul Krugman, Barbara Spencer, Jonathan Eaton, Tracey Lewis and Scott Taylor. His work has over 24,000 citations according to Google Scholar.

title: The Impact of Unions on Nonunion Wage Setting: Threats and Bargaining
title_zh: 工会对非工会工资设定的影响：威胁与谈判
title_primary: 工会对非工会工资设定的影响：威胁与谈判
title_secondary: The Impact of Unions on Nonunion Wage Setting: Threats and Bargaining
authors: David A. Green, Ben M. Sand, Iain G. Snoddy, Jeanne Tschopp
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper we provide new estimates of the impact of unions on nonunion wage setting. We allow the presence of unions to affect nonunion wages both through the typically discussed channel of nonunion firms emulating union wages in order to fend off the threat of unionisation and through a bargaining channel in which nonunion workers use the presence of union jobs as part of their outside option. We specify these channels in a search and bargaining model that includes union formation and, in our most complete model, the possibility of nonunion firm responses to the threat of unionisation. Our results indicate an important role played by union wage spillovers in lowering wages over the 1980-2010 period. We find de-unionisation can account for 38% of the decline in the mean hourly wage between 1980 and 2010, with two-thirds of that effect being due to spillovers. Both the traditional threat and bargaining channels are operational, with the bargaining channel being more important.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了工会对非工会工资设定影响的新估计。我们允许工会的存在通过两种途径影响非工会工资：一是通常讨论的非工会企业为抵御工会化威胁而模仿工会工资的渠道；二是通过谈判渠道，非工会工人将工会工作的存在作为其外部选择的一部分。我们在一个包含工会形成的搜索与谈判模型中具体化了这些渠道，并在我们最完整的模型中，考虑了非工会企业对工会化威胁可能作出的反应。我们的结果表明，在1980年至2010年期间，工会工资溢出效应在降低工资方面发挥了重要作用。我们发现，去工会化可以解释1980年至2010年间平均小时工资下降的38%，其中三分之二的影响归因于溢出效应。传统的威胁渠道和谈判渠道均发挥作用，且谈判渠道更为重要。

title: Envy in the Ballot Box: How Voting Influences Distributive Preferences
title_zh: 投票箱中的嫉妒：投票如何影响分配偏好
title_primary: 投票箱中的嫉妒：投票如何影响分配偏好
title_secondary: Envy in the Ballot Box: How Voting Influences Distributive Preferences
authors: Kajsa Hansson, Kinga Barrafrem, Lewend Mayiwar, Emil Persson, Gustav Tinghög
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Voting is a cornerstone of democratic decision-making, but it may also diffuse individual responsibility, potentially encouraging people to support actions they would avoid when deciding alone. Such diffusion of responsibility could lead voters to prioritize relative standing over collective welfare, for example by endorsing policies that reduce others’ advantages even at a cost to overall efficiency. Across two experiments (total N = 1750), including a preregistered replication, we examined whether voting contributes to envy-driven behavior in distributive decisions. Participants made choices in redistribution games under three decision-making rules: individually, through majority voting, or, in Study 2, via a Random Dictator mechanism that involved group decision-making without majority rule. In both studies, voting contributed to a higher rate of envy-driven choices, in which participants sacrificed efficiency to reduce disadvantageous inequality. This effect replicated with nearly identical magnitude in the preregistered study and was strongest when the personal cost of acting enviously was low. Results from the Random Dictator condition indicated that group decision-making alone increased envy-driven behavior, consistent with diffusion of responsibility, while majority rule amplified this effect further. These findings suggest that collective decision-making can shift social preferences by diffusing personal responsibility, thereby fostering competitive motives rather than cooperative ones. This psychological mechanism helps explain why democratic decisions about redistribution may sometimes reflect relative concerns rather than collective welfare.
abstract_zh: 投票是民主决策的基石，但它也可能分散个人责任，从而可能鼓励人们支持那些在独自决策时会避免的行为。这种责任分散可能导致选民优先考虑相对地位而非集体福利，例如支持那些以减少他人优势为代价、即使损害整体效率也在所不惜的政策。通过两项实验（总样本量N=1750），包括一项预注册复制实验，我们考察了投票是否在分配决策中促成嫉妒驱动的行为。参与者在三种决策规则下进行再分配博弈：个人决策、多数投票决策，或在研究2中通过随机独裁者机制进行的不涉及多数规则的群体决策。两项研究均表明，投票提高了嫉妒驱动选择的比例，即参与者牺牲效率以减少不利不平等。这一效应在预注册研究中以几乎相同的幅度得到复制，并且在采取嫉妒行为的个人成本较低时最为显著。随机独裁者条件的结果表明，仅群体决策本身就会增加嫉妒驱动行为，这与责任分散一致，而多数规则进一步放大了这一效应。这些发现表明，集体决策通过分散个人责任可以改变社会偏好，从而促进竞争动机而非合作动机。这一心理机制有助于解释为何关于再分配的民主决策有时可能反映相对关切而非集体福利。

abstract: We provide empirical evidence that central banks can mitigate economic crises more efficiently when they extend eligibility for their discount facility to any safe asset or solvent agent. Nineteenth-century France serves as a case study to circumvent endogeneity. Following 1863, an agricultural pandemic increased defaults outside agriculture. We exploit specificities of the discount window to create exogenous variation in central bank access. Regressions show that while the demand shock brought about by the pandemic led to an increase in defaults outside agriculture by 20 percent, this effect was significantly reduced whenever a branch office of the central bank was present.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了实证证据，表明当央行将贴现窗口的合格范围扩展至任何安全资产或偿付能力充足的机构时，其缓解经济危机的效率更高。以19世纪的法国作为案例研究，以规避内生性问题。1863年后，一场农业疫情导致农业以外的违约率上升。我们利用贴现窗口的特殊性，构建了央行准入的外生性变化。回归分析显示，尽管疫情引发的需求冲击使农业以外的违约率上升了20%，但每当央行设有分支机构时，这一影响便显著减弱。

abstract: Using a novel macro-finance model, we infer jointly the equilibrium real interest rate rt∗, trend inflation, interest rate expectations, and bond risk premia for the United States. In the model rt∗ plays a dual macro-finance role: as the benchmark real interest rate that closes the output gap and as the time-varying long-run real interest rate that determines the level of the yield curve. Our estimated rt∗ declines over the last decade, with estimation uncertainty being relatively contained. We show that both macro and financial information is important to infer rt∗. Accounting for the secular decline in interest rates renders term premia more stable than those based on stationary yield curve models.

title_secondary: Felons’ chattels and English living standards in the later fourteenth and fifteenth centuries
authors: Chris Briggs, Ben Jervis, Alice Forward, Tomasz Gromelski, Matthew Tompkins
official: 官方在线 2025-09-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The later fourteenth and fifteenth centuries have long occupied an intriguing and contested place in discussions of England's long‐run economic development. One key issue around which debate has coalesced is the living standards of the population as a whole and of different groups within it. We contribute to this debate by bringing forward new evidence on the material living standards of peasants, artisans, and wage‐earners in the countryside and small towns. This consists of lists of goods and chattels forfeited to the crown by felons, fugitives, and outlaws. This material, found in the archive of the royal escheator, is not without its problems. Yet, a careful quantitative analysis of both the overall valuations of forfeited goods and the incidence of specific items in such lists of forfeitures shows that there was relatively little change in the later fourteenth and fifteenth centuries. This is surprising, given the traditional characterization of this period as a time of rising consumption during the ‘golden age of the labourer’. This later medieval evidence is contextualized through the analysis of similar forfeiture data relating to the sixteenth century.
abstract_zh: 十四世纪末至十五世纪，在关于英格兰长期经济发展的讨论中，一直占据着一个引人入胜且颇具争议的地位。其中一个核心议题，围绕其争论焦点的是整体人口及其内部不同群体的生活水平。我们通过提供关于农民、工匠及乡村和小城镇中工薪阶层物质生活水平的新证据，为这一讨论做出贡献。这些证据包括重罪犯、逃亡者及被放逐者向王室没收的物品和动产清单。这些材料，源自王室财产管理官的档案，并非没有问题。然而，对没收物品总价值及此类没收清单中特定物品出现频率的细致定量分析显示，在十四世纪末至十五世纪期间，变化相对较小。鉴于传统上将这一时期描述为“劳动者黄金时代”中消费增长的时期，这一发现令人惊讶。这些中世纪晚期的证据，通过与十六世纪相关的类似没收数据分析，得到了背景化阐释。

title: The Aftermath of Credit Booms: Evidence from Credit Ceiling Removals
title_zh: 信贷繁荣的余波：来自信贷上限取消的证据
title_primary: 信贷繁荣的余波：来自信贷上限取消的证据
title_secondary: The Aftermath of Credit Booms: Evidence from Credit Ceiling Removals
authors: Baron, Matthew, Green, Isaac
source: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
official: 官方在线 2025-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study removals of “credit ceilings,” quantitative limits on bank credit supply imposed by many countries until the 1980s. Exploiting differences in loan types affected, we find that these removals predict increases in bank credit, residential investment, house prices, and bank stock prices, followed by reversals, recessions, and banking crises. These effects are separate from those of other financial deregulations. Overall, our results suggest that credit supply shocks do not simply amplify existing fragilities but can initiate economic boom-and-bust cycles on their own.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了“信贷上限”的取消，即直至1980年代许多国家对银行信贷供应实施的量化限制。利用受影响贷款类型的差异，我们发现这些取消预示着银行信贷、住宅投资、房价及银行股价的上涨，随后伴随逆转、经济衰退和银行业危机。这些效应与其他金融自由化措施的影响是分开的。总体而言，我们的结果表明，信贷供应冲击并非仅仅放大现有的脆弱性，而是能够独立引发经济繁荣与衰退的周期。

title: Bayesian space–time varying coefficient modeling for climate econometrics: A spatial–temporal Gaussian process approach
title_zh: 气候计量经济学中的贝叶斯时空变系数建模：一种时空高斯过程方法
title_primary: 气候计量经济学中的贝叶斯时空变系数建模：一种时空高斯过程方法
title_secondary: Bayesian space–time varying coefficient modeling for climate econometrics: A spatial–temporal Gaussian process approach
authors: Gyuhyeong Goh, Jisang Yu, Myungjin Kim, Jesse Tack
official: 官方在线 2025-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Quantifying the economic impacts of weather variables has been a key empirical topic in understanding the impacts of climate change. While panel methods, which utilize cross-sectional differences in within-unit over-time changes in weather variables, have been widely used to credibly identify the average effect of interest, there has been a growing interest in understanding the distribution of potentially heterogeneous weather effects. The heterogeneity of the effects across space and time, which can shed light on the differences in the local capacity of adaptation across regions or its evolution over time, provides important insights into developing climate policies. In this paper, we propose a novel Bayesian hierarchical modeling approach to estimate heterogeneous effects of weather variables using panel data. Our proposed approach models space–time varying coefficients via Gaussian process priors. Using the data of the corn yield from the US corn belt, we show that our proposed model outperforms several alternatives. Our findings are consistent with the literature and also provide additional insights into the localized nuances of climate change adaptation.
abstract_zh: 量化天气变量的经济影响一直是理解气候变化影响的关键实证课题。尽管利用截面差异中单位内随时间变化的天气变量的面板方法已被广泛用于可信地识别感兴趣的平均效应，但近年来，对于理解潜在异质性天气效应的分布，兴趣日益增长。这些效应在空间和时间上的异质性，能够揭示各地区适应能力的差异或其随时间的演变，为制定气候政策提供了重要见解。本文提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯层次建模方法，利用面板数据估计天气变量的异质性效应。我们提出的方法通过高斯过程先验对时空变化系数进行建模。利用美国玉米带玉米产量的数据，我们展示了所提模型优于几种替代方法。我们的发现与现有文献一致，并为气候变化适应的局部细微差别提供了额外见解。

title: Combining part-time work and social benefits: Empirical evidence from Finland
title_zh: 兼职工作与社会福利的结合：来自芬兰的实证证据
title_primary: 兼职工作与社会福利的结合：来自芬兰的实证证据
title_secondary: Combining part-time work and social benefits: Empirical evidence from Finland
authors: Salla Kalin, Tomi Kyyrä, Tuomas Matikka
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2024-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We use population-wide data from Finland to provide evidence on the impact of earnings disregard policies on part-time work during unemployment spells. The share of part-time workers among benefit recipients increased sharply from about 10% to nearly 18% over a few years after the implementation of earnings disregards in unemployment benefits and housing allowances, which allowed individuals to earn up to 300 euros per month without reductions in their benefits. Using variation in the impact of the reforms on incentives between individuals eligible for different types of benefits, we estimate that the share of individuals working part-time during unemployment increased by 4.1–4.5 percentage points (23–32%) due to the implementation of earnings disregards, corresponding to a part-time work participation elasticity with respect to the participation tax rate of approximately 1. We find no evidence that earnings disregards crowd out full-time employment, but instead find moderate positive longer-run employment effects.
abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰全国范围内的数据，为收入忽略政策对失业期间兼职工作的影响提供证据。在失业救济金和住房补贴中实施收入忽略政策后，允许个人每月赚取高达300欧元而不减少其福利，受益人中兼职工作者的比例在几年内从约10%急剧上升至近18%。利用改革对不同类型福利资格个体激励影响的差异，我们估计，由于收入忽略政策的实施，失业期间从事兼职工作的个体比例增加了4.1至4.5个百分点（23%至32%），这相当于兼职工作参与率对参与税率的弹性约为1。我们没有发现收入忽略政策挤出全职就业的证据，反而观察到适度的正向长期就业效应。
